product_category.value: Mixed-reality immersive medical and clinical training platform for nursing, health professions, and military medicine education: holographic standardized patients (HoloPatient), holographic anatomy (HoloHuman+), and browser-based AI patient conversations (AI Conversations)

evidence.quote: Mixed-reality training for medical and nursing education: hyperrealistic holographic patients, full-body anatomy, and AI patient conversations
A teaching platform, not just an app.

product_category.note: The first quote is the homepage META DESCRIPTION line.

evidence.quote: Run the same session on a mixed-reality headset, on a device already in students' hands, or with no headset at all
HoloPatient runs on mixed-reality headsets and on the phones and tablets students already carry
HoloHuman+ runs on mixed-reality headsets and on tablets and phones, with collaborative cross-device sessions.
AI Conversations runs in any modern web browser on PC or Mac

platforms.note: Platforms differ by product: HoloPatient and HoloHuman+ run on mixed-reality headsets, tablets and phones; AI Conversations runs only in a web browser ('no XR or mobile hardware required'). The home page device list shows 'Web browser' with 'PC & Mac' and 'No headset needed'. No headset brand is named on the pages read.

value: Staged, evolving scenes, linear and branching (3 to 6 clips per case)
Editable live vital signs and instructor dashboard
Real-time AI patient conversations for history-taking (65+ cases, 17 specialties)
Holographic anatomy: 2 models, 12 layered systems, about 2,500 structures
Evidence-based facilitator guides and curriculum-mapped session plans
Multi-user, cross-device sessions around one hologram
MDM device management support and faculty onboarding

evidence.quote: HoloPatient turns volumetric-captured, hyperrealistic patients into repeatable encounters
3–6 staged clips per case, linear and branching, showing realistic deterioration and improvement.
Adjust vitals in real time to match difficulty to a learner's level or your objectives.
Pause, fast-forward, and skip clips, and edit vitals from one place.
AI Conversations lets learners hold free-form, natural conversations with more than 65 AI patients
Beginner (guided) → intermediate (independent) → advanced (complex cases).
Downloadable, time-stamped transcripts and ISBARR-style summaries
With 12 systems and roughly 2,500 structures
Expert-created objectives, step-by-step questions, red-flag cues, and differential-diagnosis prompts
Ready-to-use objectives, prompts, and clinical tie-ins; use as-is or adapt.
Cross-device sessions let a whole group join one hologram together.
From device choice and MDM to faculty onboarding and ongoing support

key_capabilities.note: Case counts: HoloPatient '17+ clinical presentations', including sensitive cases (sexual assault / SANE, domestic violence). AI Conversations lists 'Multiplayer for collaborative role-play' under facilitator and patient guides. HoloHuman+ has a hand menu to 'hide, outline, isolate, label, move, or scale structures'.

target_customer.value: Nursing programs, health professions educators, and defense or military medicine training; learners include nursing, medical, and health professions students in large cohorts.

For nursing programs
For health professions educators
For defense medical training
Nursing programs need hands-on practice for large groups, in limited space, without the cost of high-fidelity manikins

target_customer.note: Menu segments: Nursing Education, Health Professions Education, Defense / Military Medicine. Only the nursing solution page was saved.

value_proposition.value: Evidence-based, curriculum-driven mixed-reality practice that builds clinical skills (assessment, clinical reasoning, communication, anatomy) through safe, repeatable practice, and lets educators standardize, cut prep time, and scale across large cohorts at a fraction of the cost of manikins and skills trainers.

evidence.quote: GigXR delivers evidence-based, curriculum-driven mixed-reality training that helps students build real clinical skills — assessment, clinical reasoning, communication, and anatomy — through safe, repeatable practice.
let educators standardize that practice, cut prep time, and scale it across large cohorts.
A fraction of the cost of manikins and skills trainers — and no dedicated simulation suite required.
